name: KNOW38
question: Does a quarantine buffer that decides the causal regime BEFORE committing consequences to a separate persistent head outperform fully fitted online HMM on noisy recurring A/B laws, without corrupting B through A return?

mechanism.style: tokenless independent local two-bank change-point staging, fixed pairwise batches, no hidden phase labels
mechanism.buffer: Exactly 8 observations per adjacent pair, with local (x,y) tuples and no long-term head writes while the group buffer is uncommitted; each decision at the eighth witnessed event uses only that buffer.
mechanism.initial_training: Start active bank0; if bank0 any physical input in the pair has seen <6, commit buffered observations to bank0 directly, capped at 6 per x. Later only after buffer classification and never before; 64 A prefix exposes each x eight times so bank0 completed.
mechanism.candidate_score: For each buffered (x,y), add clamp(log[P(y|other bank,x)/P(y|active bank,x)],-3,+3), with other bank prior Beta(1,1) when untrained; use probabilities before replaying buffered samples.
mechanism.candidate_switch: Switch at decision boundary when at least 4 of 8 terms positive and sum >=3.0; otherwise retain active bank. Cannot switch more than once per group buffer. Clear buffer after decision, replay all 8 into selected bank only, capped 6 observations per bank,x.
mechanism.memory_protection: No long-term writes to either memory between decision boundaries; inactive bank never receives the current group's buffered observations; false confidence changes forecasts but cannot partially corrupt inactive bank before decision.
mechanism.checkpoint: canonical JSON, digest verified, <=4096 bytes, exact readout and buffer state cold return at t64,128,192,256
mechanism.known_risk: The 8-event fixed staging window can delay adaptation or miss minor subgroup changes. No phase-conditioned thresholds.

controls.hmm: Exact prior KNOW36 conventional fitted online two-head global HMM as Comparator('hmm'), hazard FIT-selected from [1/128,1/32,1/8], no true phase labels.
controls.random: Identical staged local two-bank Beta memory and 8-event buffer slots, but on each 8-event boundary change bank only if SHA256('know38:random:v1:{group}:{events}') first 8 bytes mod 32 ==0; independent of consequence, law and seed; commit batch to selected bank.
controls.no_quarantine: Same model structure but a copy of the unchanged KNOW37 accumulated gate operates event-by-event with immediate memory writes rather than staging, same source.
controls.no_switch: Identical staged/bank state but never switches, 8-event buffer committed to active bank only.
controls.rolling: Unchanged KNOW36 last-8 causal memory per cell
controls.fairness: All methods see exactly same 256 public t,x,y treatment and sham events, same action/observation information; report bytes and operation times. HMM has global state and differing compute, so no equal-cost win without direct evidence.

source.type: new synthetic noise only, not original CausalGym, no reuse of KNOW34/36/37 FIT/HELD
source.laws: same fixed A,B1,B2 private_law_bit logic as KNOW36/37, not modified after prereg
source.public: c=t%8; a=(t//8)%2; x=c XOR (a<<1), repeated all 16 public action/context pairs in every 16 events and each physical x twice
source.phases: A(64), B1 or B2(64), A(64), repeat B(64); additionally sham A(256) forks from same A(64) prefix
source.private_to_evaluator_only: true law, q, private seed, future y and phase; models get exactly t,x,y only
source.first_use: One source-only first-attempt CI run after both OS focused, sealed G29 atlas, mandatory full OS regressions, original-source read-only compatibility; never FIT/HELD sources in tests. A pre-source pin failure does not open data; all executed/uncertain opening counts consume trial; never replay.

scoring.method: expected prequential Brier=q*(1-q)+(p-q)^2, q only scorer sees, pre-update prediction
scoring.primary: second B phase t192:256 expected Brier per B1 and B2, mean over 12 held worlds each
scoring.secondary: first B, return A, false sham switches, cold both bank retention, exact source counts and support, checkpoint bytes, methods' cost

frozen.P0: 12 FIT +24 disjoint HELD, exact 3072 +9216 novel source requests, exact 10752 model event occurrences per arm, public 16 pair support, no data leaks, cold checks.
frozen.P1: held A-prefix expected Brier <=0.23 separately B1/B2
frozen.H1: candidate second B mean Brier at least 0.005 lower than FIT HMM in BOTH families, with at least 9/12 paired wins per family
frozen.H2: candidate second B mean Brier at least 0.005 lower than random and no_switch and no_quarantine in BOTH families
frozen.H3: candidate A-return Brier <= FIT HMM+0.005 in BOTH families
frozen.H4: A bank t64 survives byte-identical through t192 and B bank t128 survives byte-identical through t192, all 24 HELD worlds; exact full-state cold restore at phase boundaries
frozen.H5: A-only sham false switch in <=2/24 worlds, checkpoint <=4096 bytes for all 24
frozen.decision: DEVELOPMENT_SUPPORTED only if P0,P1,H1,H2,H3,H4,H5 all pass; else DEVELOPMENT_MIXED_OR_NO_GO. SCIENTIFIC_PASS always false: synthetic source not independent native reproduction.
frozen.stop: Reject on negative; never tune or rerun held, never use source #426, modify accepted weights, merge, create controller, or invoke live owner. Preserve negative and call-cost details.
